The '''plasmaberry''' was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jontz Freight]] were looking for haulers to transport ten [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of plasberries to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dreffon IV]].<ref name="TSB">{{WEGCite|story=Tales of the Smoking Blaster|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook|stext=Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster''}}</ref>
